column_semantics: The schedule prints a descriptive Rate (2) column that includes the base/spread/floor and any PIK component in parentheses, plus a separate Interest Rate column. The stated position-level Interest Rate column is the current cash/non-PIK rate only; PIK is quoted separately in Rate (2), on top of the stated Interest Rate.

rationale: The filing uses separate Rate (2) and Interest Rate columns rather than one all-in coupon column. In every checked PIK row, the PIK amount is parenthetical in Rate (2), while the adjacent Interest Rate column reports only the non-PIK current rate. For example, GOJO prints Rate (2) as S+ 8.00%, 2.50% Floor (4.50% PIK) and Interest Rate as 11.67%, which excludes the 4.50% PIK. Fixed-rate PIK rows show the same convention: Amerijet prints 11.50% (12.00% PIK) with Interest Rate 11.50%, not 23.50%. Therefore the stated position-level Interest Rate means cash leg only, with PIK quoted separately and additive.
